race.comment: KEMAL (10) was much better second-up when chasing gamely into a midfield finish here. Has been freshened with 61 days, keeping the legs ticking over with a trial on the Inner surface. Drawn sticky but is expected to play a role third-up. RALOS STAR (9) has also been freshened and drops back to a sprinting trip. Is perhaps going better than his form reads and if the apprentice can utilise the inside draw he can give this a shake. SAPANA'S PEARL (7) has been thereabouts in her past two,  and she gets weight relief from the 61kg carried at Morven. Rock-hard fit now and is in the mix. GALLERY MASTER (11) his latest fourth here had merit after he was held up near the 200m, and that run also had him getting the bob over KEMAL but meets him 3kgs worse now. Will be hoping they pour it on in front so he can launch late. PAPER COWBOY (8) has patchy form but his narrow defeat at Dalby two back measures up. One for the exotics.
